trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Treat the remaining 54 trophies as your checklist; earn them all to reach this platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Clear the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to earn this story trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through to its completion; that is the full stated requirement.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 to claim this story milestone.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Reach the end of Chapter 3 to move this story checklist forward.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 for this milestone.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission; the list assigns this milestone gold.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run to clear this mission-specific trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist; no other condition is stated for this mission trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: See Child's Play through to completion for this award.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners for the listed story milestone.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown to add this mission trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory for this mission-specific requirement.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Bring overall game completion to 100%; this gold trophy is the full-completion check.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build a total of 250 stunts to meet the silver target.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each activity type at least once; the guide hint puts the total at nine.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations in the guide hint.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Take 20 different races to victory; the requirement is for distinct races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in the fishing challenge to satisfy this head-to-head target.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game; one finished game meets the target.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission for his strand-specific trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to earn this award.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Close out Billy's final mission for this objective.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida; the target counts strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission for the requirement tied to him.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission to clear his trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit and meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal associated with Bret to meet his requirement.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets for the silver-level collection target.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations to reach the listed count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges to clear this open-ended count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level while with your partner and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan a three-shop run with your partner and keep the wanted level active from the first robbery through the third.
trophies.missableWindow: During the back-to-back shop robberies: losing the Wanted Level breaks the required streak.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Keep discovering vehicles until the total reaches 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use one Combat Focus activation to take down all five enemies; a second activation will not count toward the same use.
trophies.missableWindow: During a single Combat Focus use: the five takedowns must happen before that use ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make the unscheduled departure from VCIA described by the trophy.
trophies.missableWindow: At VCIA when the unscheduled departure occurs; the list identifies this as a specific event.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos (tanks); the supplied description gives no further action.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone detecting you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away; both the count and escape are required.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck, then make your escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area in Leonida; the guide hint sets the total at 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; both the drink and setting are named.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in the classic style named by the trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley; the guide hint identifies the activity.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Look for the partnership moment described as having mass appeal; the list gives no other detail.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the choices tracked by the PSN trophy; the guide hint says its count reaches 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try; the listed wording makes that attempt the key.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the strange event hinted at by the description; no location or trigger is specified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by, as the description calls out.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property; the guide hint gives the total as eight.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
